نتغطرس (form IIq)
# نَتَغَطْرَسُ (nataḡaṭrasu) /na.ta.ɣatˤ.ra.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَغَطْرَسَ (taḡaṭrasa)
# نَتَغَطْرَسَ (nataḡaṭrasa) /na.ta.ɣatˤ.ra.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَغَطْرَسَ (taḡaṭrasa)
# نَتَغَطْرَسْ (nataḡaṭras) /na.ta.ɣatˤ.ras/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَغَطْرَسَ (taḡaṭrasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
